company.name: Glenvarrow Fabrication
company.blurb: A make-to-order fabricator of sheet-metal enclosures, cabinets, panels, guards and brackets for industrial customers. One plant of about 60 people: laser cutting, press brakes, welding, hardware insertion, powder coat and assembly, with customer service, purchasing, engineering and quality in the office.

result.query: deciding held parts reworked scrapped returned quality lead decides plant manager decision

results.heading: Deciding what happens to held parts
results.text:
## Deciding what happens to held parts

The quality lead decides with the plant manager whether held parts are reworked, scrapped or returned to the supplier, and records the decision on the hold. Parts on hold do not move to the next operation or ship until that decision is recorded. If a hold will make an order late, the plant manager confirms a new date and customer service tells the customer.

results.heading: Customer complaints
results.text:
## Customer complaints

The quality lead reviews each complaint customer service records, decides with the plant manager what happens to the parts, and tells customer service the decision so they can reply to the customer.

results.heading: Finding the cause
results.text:
## Finding the cause

The quality lead and the plant manager record the cause of each hold and what was changed so it does not happen again. If the cause is a supplier's material, the buyer takes it up with the supplier.
